Original reports p_rep (replication probability), not an ordinary p value; no conversion performed, so original.p.value is null. Both effect sizes are printed partial eta-squared rather than unqualified eta-squared. Original supplied p.4 matches PDF page including cover; replication supplied p.5 corresponds to different pagination from retrieved author manuscript. Replication full-text HTML parse omits Greek symbols; its printed p 2 notation is retained in the quotation and interpreted as partial eta-squared from ANOVA context and matching original-effect notation.
